raw_segments.text: Yes, my youngest is not sixteen. Perhaps she is full young to be much in company.
But really, ma'am, I think it would be very hard upon younger sisters that they should not have
their share of society and amusement, because the elder may not have the means or inclination to
marry early. The last born has as good a right to the pleasures of youth as the first, and to be
kept back on such a motive. I think it would not be very likely to promote sisterly affection or
